positive_cases.name: ad_group_member_added
positive_cases.scenario: Directory cmdlet adds a member to a privileged directory group.
positive_cases.rationale: Membership command and privileged group selections both match.

positive_cases.name: local_administrators_added
positive_cases.scenario: Legacy command adds a member to the local administrators group.
positive_cases.rationale: Membership command and privileged group selections both match.

negative_cases.name: non_privileged_group_added
negative_cases.scenario: Member added to an ordinary application group.
negative_cases.rationale: The privileged group selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: group_membership_query
negative_cases.scenario: Privileged group membership listed for an access review.
negative_cases.rationale: The membership command selection does not match a query cmdlet.

negative_cases.name: member_removed
negative_cases.scenario: Member removed from a privileged group.
negative_cases.rationale: The membership command selection matches only addition verbs.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
